authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Reviewed whole-form continuation of Goj bʰāṛī “heavy” (f_l5b7ovd5m66vi). Family evidence: CDIAL 9465 bhārika gives bhārī heavy. The i-final form fits; a/o-final bhāro needs distinguishing an adjectival inflection from bhāra load. Reviewed comparator: Goj bhari “heavy” (f_3jorpste2lbde). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved. The present source form was inspected for phonetic and gloss differences; normalization was used only to find it, and its exact spelling is preserved.
